ad.summary: You will provide engineering capability for the CIB Front Arena platform. This is a hands-on role covering the full delivery lifecycle: understanding a business problem, designing the solution, then building, testing, implementing and supporting it in production. You will help keep the platform aligned with evolving Global Markets requirements, and act as a senior technical authority for Front Arena engineering.
responsibilities: Design, develop, enhance and support solutions within Front Arena.
Develop and maintain Front Arena core scripts, including components such as FValidation.
Build solutions using Python, ACM/AEL, ADFL, ATS, ADS, AMBA/AMB and relevant Front Arena APIs.
Troubleshoot complex business-raised production issues across batch and process functionality, perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
Participate in Front Arena upgrades and migrations, including moves to cloud.
Translate business requirements into Front Arena technical solutions that are performant, maintainable and aligned with platform standards.
Assess whether a requirement is best met through standard Front Arena capability, configuration, scripting, integration or custom development.
Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customisation, performance issues or long-term support risk.
Review technical designs, solution approaches and code before production implementation.
Own complex and ambiguous problems through to resolution.
Engage the Front Arena vendor where product expertise or vendor intervention is needed.
Work with version control, branching, merging, pull requests and team-based development workflows.
Establish and reinforce development standards and engineering practices, and mentor engineers with less Front Arena experience.
Support technical analysis of high-severity incidents and identify systemic problems instead of repeated tactical fixes.
Improve documentation to reduce dependency on individual technical experts.
must_have: 8+ years relevant engineering experience, including 5+ years hands-on Front Arena development and Python experience.
Advanced skills in Front Arena APIs, ACM, AEL and ADFL, plus strong Front Arena core scripts, production troubleshooting and solution design.
Strong version control experience (preferably Git and GitHub) and CI/CD with automated deployment.
Experience supporting Front Arena deployments in cloud-hosted environments (AWS or Azure).
Experience supporting Front Arena in Global Markets environments, with exposure to Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives or Treasury products.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Senior Front Arena Engineer
Company: Absa Group
About the company: Empowering Africa’s tomorrow, together…one story at a time. With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.
Purpose of the role: Provide engineering capability for the CIB Front Arena platform. The role requires a hands-on engineer who can take ownership of complex Front Arena development and technical problem solving across the full delivery lifecycle, from understanding a business problem and designing the solution through to development, testing, implementation and production support. The successful candidate must have strong development experience within Front Arena, combined with Python engineering skills and an understanding of Corporate and Investment Banking. The role will work closely with business stakeholders and product teams to ensure the Front Arena platform continues to meet evolving Global Markets requirements.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Design, develop, enhance and support solutions within Front Arena.
  - Develop and maintain Front Arena core scripts, including components such as FValidation.
  - Develop solutions using Python, ACM/AEL, ADFL, ATS, ADS, AMBA/AMB and relevant Front Arena APIs.
  - Troubleshoot complex business-raised production issues across batch and process functionality, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
  - Participate in Front Arena upgrades and migrations (e.g. Cloud).
  - Ensure Front Arena solutions are performant, maintainable and aligned with platform standards.
  - Translate business requirements into robust Front Arena technical solutions.
  - Provide technical direction for complex enhancements and platform changes.
  - Assess whether requirements should be addressed through standard Front Arena capabilities, configuration, scripting, integration or custom development.
  - Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customisation, performance issues or long-term support risk.
  - Review technical designs, solution approaches and code before production implementation.
  - Own complex problems through to resolution rather than relying on detailed technical direction from others.
  - Engage with the Front Arena vendor where product expertise or vendor intervention is required.
  - Working with version control, branching, merging, pull requests, and team-based development workflows.
  - Act as a senior technical authority for Front Arena engineering.
  - Review technical designs, solution approaches and code before production implementation.
  - Establish and reinforce development standards and engineering practices.
  - Mentor engineers with less Front Arena experience.
  - Support technical analysis of high-severity incidents.
  - Identify systemic problems rather than repeatedly implementing tactical fixes.
  - Improve documentation and reduce dependency on individual technical SMEs.
  - Work effectively with Product, Business, Support, Infrastructure, Data and other engineering teams.
Must-have requirements:
  - 8+ years relevant engineering experience, including 5+ years hands-on Front Arena development and Python experience
  - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  - Experience supporting Front Arena deployments within cloud-hosted environments (AWS or Azure).
  - Advanced: Front Arena APIs / ACM / AEL / ADFL
  - Strong: Front Arena core scripts / Production troubleshooting / Solution design / Version control (preferably Git and GitHub) / CI/CD and automated deployment
  - Experience supporting Front Arena within Global Markets environments, including exposure to Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives or Treasury products.
  - A hands-on engineer first, rather than purely an architect or manager.
  - Comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous technical problems.
  - Strong at debugging existing Front Arena implementations.
  - Able to understand both business context and technical consequences.
  - Pragmatic about when to configure, customise, integrate or escalate to the vendor.
  - Comfortable working in a production-critical banking environment.
  - Able to communicate clearly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  - Comfortable providing technical leadership while continuing to write and review code.
  - Bachelor's Degree: Information Technology
Nice-to-have:
  - Power BI and data visualization
  - Data analysis and reporting
  - AI-assisted development tools and automation
  - Microsoft Power Platform
Location: Sandton
Team notes: Works closely with business stakeholders and product teams, and with Product, Business, Support, Infrastructure, Data and other engineering teams.
Employment equity statement: Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.
Accessibility statement: We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Senior Front Arena Engineer

Absa Group

Sandton

About us
Empowering Africa's tomorrow, together…one story at a time. With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.

About the role
You will provide engineering capability for the CIB Front Arena platform. This is a hands-on role covering the full delivery lifecycle: understanding a business problem, designing the solution, then building, testing, implementing and supporting it in production. You will help keep the platform aligned with evolving Global Markets requirements, and act as a senior technical authority for Front Arena engineering.

Your team
You work closely with business stakeholders and product teams, and with Product, Business, Support, Infrastructure, Data and other engineering teams.

What you'll do
• Design, develop, enhance and support solutions within Front Arena.
• Develop and maintain Front Arena core scripts, including components such as FValidation.
• Build solutions using Python, ACM/AEL, ADFL, ATS, ADS, AMBA/AMB and relevant Front Arena APIs.
• Troubleshoot complex business-raised production issues across batch and process functionality, perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
• Participate in Front Arena upgrades and migrations, including moves to cloud.
• Translate business requirements into Front Arena technical solutions that are performant, maintainable and aligned with platform standards.
• Assess whether a requirement is best met through standard Front Arena capability, configuration, scripting, integration or custom development.
• Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customisation, performance issues or long-term support risk.
• Review technical designs, solution approaches and code before production implementation.
• Own complex and ambiguous problems through to resolution.
• Engage the Front Arena vendor where product expertise or vendor intervention is needed.
• Work with version control, branching, merging, pull requests and team-based development workflows.
• Establish and reinforce development standards and engineering practices, and mentor engineers with less Front Arena experience.
• Support technical analysis of high-severity incidents and identify systemic problems instead of repeated tactical fixes.
• Improve documentation to reduce dependency on individual technical experts.

What you need
• 8+ years relevant engineering experience, including 5+ years hands-on Front Arena development and Python experience.
• Advanced skills in Front Arena APIs, ACM, AEL and ADFL, plus strong Front Arena core scripts, production troubleshooting and solution design.
• Strong version control experience (preferably Git and GitHub) and CI/CD with automated deployment.
• Experience supporting Front Arena deployments in cloud-hosted environments (AWS or Azure).
• Experience supporting Front Arena in Global Markets environments, with exposure to Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives or Treasury products.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have
• Power BI and data visualisation
• Data analysis and reporting
• AI-assisted development tools and automation
• Microsoft Power Platform

We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.

Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.

This role suits a hands-on engineer rather than a purely architectural or management profile. You will keep writing and reviewing code while providing technical leadership, work in a production-critical banking environment, and explain technical consequences clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
